title: Input log
description: The free-choice sequence of one match (or a stand-alone rack): placements, declarations, spot requests, and option picks, in order. Everything else — racks, event logs, adjudications, race scores, re-rack snapshots — is derived on replay. No wall-clock value appears anywhere in the log; array order is the sequence. Entry fields mirror the rules machine's input vocabulary (#6); frame, units, and the strike declaration follow #7 §2 and §4.

format_version.description: Bumped only when an entry's meaning changes; never for additions or key reordering.

profile.description: Profile id; the record lives at config/profiles/<id>.json.

match_seed.description: Rack-construction seed. Per-rack seeds derive from it: rack i gets the SplitMix64 stream seeded with match_seed after i+1 steps (#14).

noise_seed.description: Execution-noise stream seed. One draw is consumed for every declaration carrying from_policy, in log order.

difficulty.description: The match's policy difficulty and checkpoint; inert when both seats are human.

race_target.description: Racks needed to win the match.

checkpoint.description: Policy artifact identity used by any policy seat (e.g. the sha256 of the served .onnx).

call.description: The declaration's call: a ball plus pocket, a safety, or — on the break only — nothing.

pocket.description: Pocket id per the rules section's vocabulary.

domain.description: The ball-in-hand domain the incoming player is placing within, as adjudicated by the rules layer.

spot_request.description: The WPA 1.6 second-paragraph request to spot the legal object ball nearest the head string; legal only when every legal object ball is above the head string.

from_policy.description: True when a policy seat committed this declaration; the only declarations execution noise applies to, and only on replay's derivation from noise_seed.

aim.description: Unit horizontal aim direction in the table frame.

speed.description: Cue-ball launch speed, millimetres per second.

a.description: Right/left tip offset as a fraction of the miscue envelope: a > 0 is the shooter's right, a < 0 the shooter's left.

b.description: Above/below-centre tip offset as a fraction of the miscue envelope: b > 0 is above centre (the follow side at zero elevation), b < 0 below it (the draw side).

spin.description: Cue-tip contact offset in the plane perpendicular to the cue axis, as a fraction of the miscue envelope (1.0 = the limit; the b axis is the world-up direction projected into that plane and a completes the frame). Dimensionless and scale-free: the sim converts at the input boundary, offset_mm = rho_max * value with rho_max = R*mu/sqrt(1+mu^2) = 14.70 mm at mu = 0.6. The envelope is enforced at the input boundary: |(a, b)| <= 1 is legal (the boundary comparison carries a 1e-3 mm tolerance on the tip offset, about 7e-5 in this unit, so a value authored exactly at the limit commits); anything past it is an input error and is never simulated.

option.description: One option of the current AwaitingChoice tree: break-foul, illegal-break, 8-on-break, or the stalemate offer/accept; ids are defined by the rules corpus.
